MQe does not support JMS Topics.

Explanation.p: MQe only supports JMS Queues (the Point-to-Point mechanism in terms of the JMS specification), and not JMS Topics (the Publish/Subscribe mechanism in terms of the JMS specification).

OperatorResponse.p: Only JMS Queues can be used with MQe. If JMS Topics are needed, a different JMS provider must be used.
